summary: Qaadri, an owner-confirmed member of the pro-Palestine Muslim community, proposed a ceasefire resolution in December 2023, an action listed on CAIR-SFBA's tracker though not a verified roll-call transcript. CAIR Action endorsed his general campaign and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally, both organizations that weigh ceasefire positions in their assessments. His campaign platform addresses only local Dublin issues. The personal ceasefire proposal, community membership, and directional endorsements together ground the assessment.
